blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Articles 52 to 78 deal with the Union Executive, whereas Articles 79 to 122 deal with the Parliament.
The President is elected indirectly by a single transferable vote for a 5-year term.
The Vice President serves as the Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.
The Prime Minister acts as the real executive, while the Attorney General is the highest legal officer.
Article 61 specifically prescribes the procedure for the impeachment of the President.
Distinction between Real Executive (Prime Minister) and Nominal Executive (President) is a recurring question.
The Attorney General is frequently asked about as the highest legal officer in the country.
